title: Scoped algorithm no-match from closed coverage and hard exclusions

component_roles.JP-025@1: Classify the declaration for a named candidate universe; code verifies the actual permitted identifiers and source revision.
component_roles.JP-023@2: Classify one hard task requirement against one method's documented capability passage.

decision: If and only if the exact named candidate universe is closed and every method is excluded by at least one high-probability, source-bound contradiction to a hard requirement, preview SCOPED_NO_MATCH. Otherwise preview a candidate for inspection, seek missing evidence, expand search, or review invalid data.
consumer: Offline read-only compose_verified() in consumer.py. The host authenticates and binds component receipts, source bytes, candidate IDs, task revision, and requirement IDs before calling it. The result is a preview for human method research, never selection or execution authority.
exclusions: Treating silence, low probability, or incomplete coverage as exclusion
evaluation: Eight same-author, source-backed integration questions plus adversarial deterministic consumer tests. No independently authored cases or live deployment.
